attribution.heading: Data sources
attribution.note: Elevation comes from the contour map you uploaded. The sources above supply the soil, land cover and rainfall used to turn that terrain into a runoff volume, and the imagery you see beneath the overlays.
village.heading: Find a village
village.hint: Latin or Devanagari; spelling need not be exact.
explore.hint: Click anywhere on the map to delineate the catchment above that point.
explore.heading: Clicked catchment
explore.limitHit: It moved as far as it was allowed, so it may not have reached a channel — treat this area with caution.
explore.touchesEdge: This catchment reaches the edge of the survey, so part of the contributing area lies outside the map and the area shown is a lower bound.
results.showSites.all: all the sites this survey yielded — raise “Maximum sites” and re-run for more
